Independent SymPy Laurent determinants for q5,7,9
correctness.rationale: For g(t)=(1-|t|)_+, b=5/2 and a=4/(5q), q>=3 odd, the normalized rational Zibulski–Zeevi fiber matrix has two rows and q columns with entries F_{x-2ell/q}((-1)^j z)/sqrt(5); the odd-denominator x->x+1/q symmetry reduces fibers to x in [0,1/q]. The finite Laurent sums give a determinant for q>=7 of 16/(25q z^5)(z^6-2z^4-z^2-1), and q=5 requires a second piecewise minor with z^6+z^4+2z^2-1. Independent rational-Laurent exact algebra reproduced q=5 both branches and q=7,9 minors (all normalized factors checked). The common squared modulus is -8v^3+4v^2+8v+5 whose true minimum on [-1,1] is (173-26sqrt(13))/27>0. The exceptional q=3 quartic minor coefficient inequalities yield at least 2/125. Cauchy–Binet and trace <=338q/125 then imply positive A3=2/63375 and Aq=128(173-26sqrt(13))/(570375q^3). Finite checked q are corroboration; the symbolically displayed all-odd-q minor formula, piecewise bounds and rational-fiber theorem carry the infinite proof.
residual_risks: The stated frame bounds are nonsharp and depend on the specified Fourier/Zak normalization.
The rational ZZ-fiber equivalence is an external standard theorem; scripts alone do not prove it.

value.rationale: Answers a specifically motivated numerator-two part of an unsettled rational Gabor frameset for a natural compactly supported tent window, giving global all-position positive frame bounds for infinitely many odd q, not isolated numerical frame examples. A nontrivial piecewise minor at q=5, exceptional q=3 quartic and all-odd-q cubic certificate are reusable constructive arguments.
residual_risks: Not a classification for even q, other modulations or sharp bounds.
